title: Why was the traffic heaviest from 7 to 8 a.m.?
description: The longest bar of the traffic graph is compared with the bars on either side of it, and a reason for the rush is found by thinking about what people do at that hour. The reason is then checked against the bars that follow.
teaching_notes: One idea: the longest bar is the peak, and the reason for a peak comes from what people do at that time. Watch for answers that only say the bar is the longest.

video_script.why: The child finds the longest bar, measures how far it stands above its neighbours, and gives a reason for the peak.
video_script.substitution: Find the longest bar, compare it with the bars on either side, and give a reason from daily life.
video_script.anchor: the horizontal bar graph of vehicles passing a busy crossing in Delhi in each hour from six in the morning to noon
video_script.payoff_line: The traffic was heaviest because people were travelling to offices and schools at that time

final_answer.value: Open-ended: people were travelling to offices and schools at that time
final_answer.spoken: people were travelling to offices and schools in the hour from seven to eight

maths_rules: 7-8 a.m. is the longest bar, 1200 vehicles, 12 units
the hour before is about 150 and the hour after is 1000
1200 - 1000 = 200 vehicles more than the hour after; 1200 - 150 = 1050 vehicles more than the hour before
check: the bars after 7-8 are shorter: 1000, 800, 700, 600
video_script.design: One idea: find the peak bar, measure its gaps, then give a reason from daily life. The graph stays on the board all video. The reason is open-ended, so the video gives the worklist's example reason and says so.
open_questions: The question is open-ended. The video gives the worklist's example reason and does not claim it is the only one.

narration: <bookmark mark='peak'/>Step one, pick the longest bar, which is the hour from seven to eight.
<bookmark mark='after'/>It is two hundred more than the next hour. One thousand two hundred take away one thousand is two hundred.

<bookmark mark='rush'/>Traffic shoots up in this one hour and falls after it, so something special happens then.

beats.on_screen: Answer: the traffic was heaviest because people were travelling to offices and schools at that time
